description: Take one of the project's allowed_actions, with the ids it names: confirm_plan (spec_version; starts the paid work - only once the user agreed to the plan; it is charged by what it uses), answer (answers: question id -> answer), top_up (pause_id; max_credits raises a credit cap that ran out), one_more_round, accept_as_is, pause, resume, cancel, feedback (version, value), deliver_now (the agents read the waiting messages at once, interrupting the step they are on). COSTS CREDITS for confirm_plan, top_up, one_more_round and the scoping answers.

action.description: One of the allowed_actions get_project listed

max_credits.description: confirm_plan, top_up, one_more_round: a higher credit cap for the whole project, agreed by the user

spec_version.description: confirm_plan: the plan version shown to the user
